major_findings: The exact uncovered span is atomized into 40 source-first review records; 36 are proposed for promotion and four remain unpromoted because the source phrase or condition scope is unresolved.
W10-925 preserves `畅顺耳` literally; no contextual emendation is inferred.
W10-926 preserves `至少` literally in `浮华性质至少之星系`; no correction is inferred.
W10-929 holds the debt-assumption clause because the referent/scope of `化忌` is not explicit.
W10-952 holds the wealth-pattern clause because the logical relation between the two `若` condition clauses is not fully explicit.
W10-947 is assigned YEAR only because the source explicitly states `流年命宫或财帛宫见煞忌刑劫之年为克应`; no decade layer or numeric time parameter is added.
P05-COV-GAP-001 is closed only if this bounded batch is accepted; 26 residual local source gaps remain explicitly listed.
